historical_record.description: The building at 5810 Mission Street contained Below Market Rate rental apartments.

The City Planning Commission approved, as amended, the amendment of Motion No. 13347 to allow conversion of three below market rate rental apartments into three below market rate dwelling units for sale for owner occupancy at 5810 Mission Street.
